annotation.title_clean: 国家卫生健康委办公厅关于印发职业病医院基本标准（二级、三级）的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the National Health Commission on Issuing the Basic Standards for Occupational Disease Hospitals (Level II and III)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家卫生健康委办公厅 (General Office of the National Health Commission)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese National Health Commission notice issuing basic standards for Level II and III occupational disease hospitals, specifying beds, departments, staffing, floor area and equipment. Existing hospitals must adjust within one year and be verified by health authorities. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Level II hospitals need 100-199 beds; Level III 200+ beds
Minimum departments, staffing ratios and qualified occupational disease diagnosticians specified
At least 45 square metres of floor area per bed
Required basic medical equipment lists for each level
Existing hospitals must conform within one year; health authorities verify compliance
